name: dhun-web
description: DHUN's interface in the browser — a mirror of the app's Compose UI. Engineering preview: audio playback is not proven from this origin. Ships no runtime dependency.

comments.dependencies: None, deliberately. The app ships no runtime dependency: no framework, no CDN, no icon library, no webfont, no analytics. Dev tooling is Node's own (http, test runner) for the same reason.
